Population increased in Guildford

The estimated population of Guildford in 2024 was 151,359 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

This meant that Guildford's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Guildford increased by 5.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, Guildford was also among the 20% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Guildford

The average (median) age fell to 38.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Guildford has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Guildford is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Guildford's population of 151,359 usual residents was made up of:

  • 25,802 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17%)
  • 99,505 people aged 16 to 64 years, (65.7%)
  • 26,052 people aged 65 years and over, (17.2%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Guildford has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (65.7% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Guildford, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Guildford
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Guildford, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 215 people (0.1%). In total, there were 1,320 births and 1,105 deaths in Guildford.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 378 (-0.3%). There were 15,728 people entering the area and 16,106 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Guildford's population of 2,282 (1.5%) as a result of 4,255 people entering the area and 1,973 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Guildford was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Guildford in mid-2023 is 149,094.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 477 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 559 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 82 people.
